title: Apple delays its smart glasses until 2027 to prioritize privacy
summary: The company seeks to compete with Meta's Ray-Ban and avoid the privacy issues that have affected other devices.

title: Nvidia would endorse $250 billion for OpenAI to build a data center in Ohio
summary: The plan includes a possible $350 billion deal to finance chips on campus, according to the WSJ.

title: Minecraft Java Edition increases its RAM requirements to 16 GB ahead of the transition to Vulkan
summary: After 17 years, the game raises the recommended memory for the first time, affecting players with old equipment.

title: Chinese chip maker CXMT revalues more than 460% on its debut on the Shanghai stock exchange
summary: The company will focus its investment on DRAM production and not HBM, according to its IPO application.

title: NVIDIA presents its Vera CPU to design future processors and accelerates chip development
summary: Initial tests show up to 1.5 times higher performance in automation and design tasks.

title: A user installs spikes and a taser on his Steam Deck to prevent his family from draining the battery
summary: The homemade security system includes a Raspberry Pi, camera and speaker to scare away 'battery thieves'.

title: Hugging Face CEO demands 'radical transparency' from OpenAI after its recent security breach
summary: Clement Delangue asks OpenAI to reveal all the details of the hack it suffered to avoid future incidents.

title: AMD confirms that Zen 7 will be the last generation compatible with the AM5 socket before AM6
summary: The manufacturer will split Zen 7 into three EPYC families for servers, with launch planned for 2028.
